why: A control outside a home is the highest-friction family (21 waivers) and a literal search on Link re-runs loaders; both need real rule bodies caught at write time.
what: Rule bodies in packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/rules/structure/control-home* and router-search*, which v3-gr-3b-structure-rest created as shells and ids, plus fixtures under packages/basalt-ui/test/fixtures/lint/ (the path the index and ARCHITECTURE use).
contract: Read docs/v3/concepts/guardrails.md section 4 (rows 10, 11 and the control-home paragraph) and docs/v3/concepts/controls-url-state.md section 9 (predicate). Ids exist already; this adds zero ids. Read docs/v3/spikes/control-home.md: above 5 waivers per app after the shutterflow and argo port means redesign homes, so file a signal instead of widening the rule.
exemplar: Follow the finished rules in src/lint/rules/structure/{import-boundary,primitive-bypass}* and test/fixtures/lint/import-bypass/ for rule, message and fixture layout.
change: One concern: the two rule bodies. control-home (file-local, wrapper-only): flag a JSX use of ui/select, combobox, segmented, number-field, slider, switch, checkbox or radio-group in app code whose lexical ancestors in that file are none of FormField, FilterSet, ViewTabs, ControlHome, a filterSlot.custom render or a handle-taking composite; same for page-slot and Section/Page body children. Handle-taking composite = a JSX element with an attribute named `handle`, `control` or `field` whose value is a `.field.<name>` member chain or an identifier hoisted from one (resolved at Program:exit). router-search: literal `search=` on Link, `loaderDeps: ({ search }) => search`, `<ViewTransition>` around Outlet, an inline validateSearch reading window, document, localStorage, sessionStorage, Date or Math.random (including Zod .default(() => new Date())). Messages name the fix (ControlHome or filterSlot.custom; field.link(), narrow deps, a pure validator). Ships: rule = these two ids; skill snippet = none; test = RuleTester under oxlint plugins-dev and ESLint plus fixtures run through the hook.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution; make sync-self its own commit.
proof: Per form: one seeded offender and one clean file, run through `basalt-ui lint --hook post-edit` with the event JSON on stdin from a subdirectory.
acceptance: make check passes, including RuleTester for both ids under oxlint plugins-dev and ESLint.
Fixtures body-children and filterSlot-custom-with-useState exit 2 through the hook and the message contains `ControlHome` or `filterSlot.custom`.
One failing fixture per router-search form (4), each message naming its fix.
A file-level `// oxlint-disable control-home` fixture yields a `waiver-needs-reason` finding (rule of v3-gr-3b-structure-rest, not edited here); a line-level directive with a reason is clean.
`git diff --name-only` shows no change to src/lint/table.ts or the preset and no new rule id.
out_of_scope: New ids, cross-file home inference, hand-rolled filters that import nothing from basalt, the shells themselves (v3-gr-3b-structure-rest).
